entries.title: Jeremiah 9:1
segments:
vv 1-2. 
 
While God's faithful servants abhor the ways of wicked men, and loathe their companionship, they feel deep compassion for them in view of the ruin which they are bringing upon themselves.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:2
segments: A lodging-place of wayfaring men; anciently, as now, such lodging-places were erected for the accommodation of caravans.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:3
segments:
vv 3-9. 
 
In this perverse and fallen world it is hard to find any who are worthy of perfect confidence; but when the mass of a people have become thoroughly false and treacherous, their destruction is at hand.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:6
segments: Thy habitation is in the midst of deceit; Jehovah here addresses the prophet.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:8
segments: An arrow shot out; rather, "a murderous arrow."

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:10
segments:
For the mountains; that is, on account of their impending desolation. 
 
  The fowl--the beast are fled; a figure to express utter desolation. Compare

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:12
segments:
vv 12-16. 
 
The highest wisdom of statesmen and rulers is to understand that the prosperity of a nation lies in fearing and obeying God, and its destruction in forgetting him and trampling under foot his laws.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:23
segments: Glory in his wisdom--his might--his riches; all these resources would fail to deliver the Jews from the calamities which God was about to bring upon them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:24
segments: That he understandeth and knoweth me; because a true knowledge of God, which includes love and obedience, is the only salvation of individuals or of nations.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:25
segments:
Punish--circumcised with the uncircumcised; make no distinction between the circumcised Jews and the uncircumcised Gentiles; because, as the next verse explains, the Jews are "uncircumcised in the heart." 
 
vv 25-26. 
 
When God's covenant people imitate the sins of the ungodly, they must expect to suffer punishment with them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 9:26
segments: Are in the utmost corners; or, "have the corners of their hair shorn;" a description of the Arabian tribes.
